paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: layout contract, headless measurement and rule-based audit for UI work (web pages, Godot
scenes, declared layouts), plus a GUI panel with violations and annotated breakpoints.
# dsh-ui-layout
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops an AI agent from drawing UI blind.
Agents usually start painting before they know the coordinate system, the unit, the breakpoints or t

he
stacking rules of the page they are building. This plugin forces a `contract -> measure -> audit`

loop and
gates UI-file writes on the contract:
1. `ui_contract` — declare the layout facts **before** writing UI code (coordinate system, unit, vie

wports,
breakpoints, grid, spacing/type scales, layer stack, named regions, minimum interactive targ

et size).
2. `ui_measure` — render a local HTML file or a localhost page in headless Chrome at the d

eclared viewports and
record real geometry: bounding boxes, computed styles, scroll overflow, stacki

ng/source order and
hit-test samples for interactive controls. Godot `.tscn` scenes and declared lay

out JSON are measured without
a browser (rects resolved from anchors/offsets or canvas coordinates).
3. `ui_audit` — run deterministic rules over the measured data and report violations with node sele

ctors,
evidence and fix hints. Fix the source, re-run until the verdict is `pass`.
4. `ui_diff` — co

mpare two snapshots and report appeared / disappeared / moved / resized nodes beyond a pixel
thresho

ld, so a layout change can be proved local instead of eyeballed.
5. `ui_matrix` — sweep every declar

ed breakpoint in one pass, run the same rules per breakpoint, and write a
rule × breakpoint matrix,

one PNG per breakpoint, annotated violation PNGs (red boxes + numbered legend) and a
self-contained

HTML acceptance page. A page that passes at one width can overflow, overlap or lose controls at
anot

her.
6. A **Web GUI panel** ("UI 布局" in the left sidebar) shows the contract, latest verdict, violat

ion cards, the

A tarball built with `npm pack` installs the same way (`install_bundle` with the `.tgz` path); that

## Publish
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`publish:market` prints the jsDelivr index URL to add as an index source and the `plugin_manager` in

stall
target. `publish:market -- --otp=123456` passes a one-time password; `-- --dry-run` shows the

tarball contents
without uploading. The index must be published at the same version as the package
(
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-ui-layout@<version>/market-index.json`).
`application: "applied"` means the running composition recomposed. `application: "failed"` carries a
`diagnostic` string with the real activation error. Replacing an installed npm package needs an app

restart;
a linked local checkout reloads through the bundle toggle.
Requirements: Google Chrome (or Edge / Chromium) on the machine, and `puppeteer-core` resolvable fro

m the DSH
profile. The plugin finds Chrome via `CHROME_PATH` / `PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH`, then the

usual Windows,
macOS and Linux locations. `puppeteer-core` is resolved from the DSH profile directo

ry, `DSH_HOME`, the
process cwd, or the plugin directory.
## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`ui_audit` returns `verdict: pass|fail`, `counts`, and per-violation `rule`, `severity`, `viewportId

`,
`message`, `selector` and `fixHint` in the stored report. Exit criterion for an agent: `pass`, or

every
remaining violation explicitly accepted by the user.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations (P1)
- Measures **rendered DOM** for HTML files and localhost URLs; framework dev servers work through th

eir URL, but
there is no component-level import or screenshot baseline yet.
- Engine sources cover G

odot 4 `.tscn` text scenes and declared layout JSON. Godot rects use Control
anchors/offsets only (t

heme `custom_minimum_size` is not applied), container-managed children are approximated
and excluded

from geometric rules, and no engine scaling factor is applied. Unity YAML and Unreal are not
suppor

ted yet.
- Hit-test sampling is 5 points per element, which is accurate for rectangular controls but

can miss small
irregular overlays.
- The soft gate covers file-write tools only; shell writes bypas

s it.
- The Web GUI panel is a read-only viewer over the workspace store: it lists workspaces seen b

y the layout tools
(URL-only sources never appear), caps the violation list at 127 and the tree at 6

00 nodes, and needs a page
refresh after a plugin reload to pick up client-side changes.
- Breakpoin

t heights come from the contract viewport with the same width, otherwise 900px; the sweep covers
wid

ths only, not short-height/landscape cases.
- `zorder.inversion` only inspects non-interactive nodes

that declare a numeric `z-index` of 100 or more, at
three sample points; it reports the covering el

ement and the trapping ancestor, not the full paint list.
Elements with `z-index: auto` that lose be

cause of paint order between contexts still surface as
`occlusion.hit-test` when they are interactiv

e.
- `spacing.drift` only compares adjacent siblings under the same parent, skips absolute/fixed/inl

ine nodes and
gaps below 6px, and only reports 1-3px drift; cross-section spacing and larger hand-pi

cked values are out of
scope for now.
- `safearea.obstruction` recognises bar-shaped fixed/sticky el

ements only, skips ancestor/descendant pairs and
uses a fixed 35% coverage threshold; `safeArea.inse

ts` come from the contract, not from real
`env(safe-area-inset-*)` device values (headless Chrome ha

s no device safe area).
- `interaction.dead` is static-signal based: page JS is not executed, so an

`href="#"` link with a JS click
